info.name: UK DARKER
info.description: A sleek, dark-themed hacker-style design for Google. This theme features a black background with neon blue-green accents, inspired by cyber aesthetics. Ideal for those who love coding, hacking vibes, or simply want a futuristic browsing experience.
info.additionalInfo:
Premium Version Enhancements:
✅ Animated neon-glow effect on buttons and links.
✅ Custom hacker-style font for an immersive experience.
✅ More transparency & glitch effects for a futuristic look.
✅ Dark mode extension for YouTube and Gmail.
